skills.comment: Editable allowlist of skill paths (agent-skill SKILL.md dirs, e.g. ~/.agents/skills/<name>); user config ~/.clippy/config.json deep-merges over this. Empty = no explicit skills exposed. Pi auto-discovery is disabled when a non-empty allowlist is set. Allowlisted skills are model tools — full use (web/write/bash) requires build mode; sandbox (read-only tools) limits them to reading.

logging.comment: Write a timestamped JSONL chat transcript per conversation (prime + each sub-clippy) under ~/.clippy/logs. Set false to disable.

memory.comment: Background memory curator: a proxy model decides which facts are durable and persists them to ~/.clippy/memory. every_n_turns batches how often the curator runs; curator_model empty = reuse the prime model.
